title_zh: Vlog教程｜更适合普通人的手机拍摄教学
title_en: Vlog Tutorial | Mobile Filming for Regular People

scenes.scene_zh: 开场：这是你最近拍摄的无Log素材，兴冲冲举起手机一顿乱拍，回来发现273个视频，不知从哪开始剪，还影响了游玩心情。
scenes.scene_en: Opening: These are your latest unstyled clips—you excitedly whipped out your phone and shot everything, only to come home to 273 videos and no idea where to start, ruining the trip mood too.
scenes.context: 乱拍导致素材爆炸，是普通人拍vlog的通病。
sentences: 这是你最近拍摄的无Log素材，兴冲冲的举起手机就一顿乱拍。
These are your latest clips—you excitedly whipped out your phone and shot everything.
The chaotic-shooting trap.
回来发现273个视频，根本不知道该怎么开始剪。
You come home to 273 videos and have no idea where to start editing.
Too much, no structure.
出不了篇就算了，还严重影响了自己当时游玩的心情。
Not posting is bad enough—it even ruined your mood during the trip.
Shooting without a plan hurts.

scenes.scene_zh: 新方法：既然不知道拍什么，那在每个场景下只记录四种画面——场景空镜、物品特写、人物全景、人物近景。
scenes.scene_en: The new method: since you don't know what to shoot, just record four kinds of shots in every scene—scene wide shot, item close-up, full-body person, and close person shots.
scenes.context: 四类镜头的固定配方，让拍摄有章法。
sentences: 既然不知道要拍什么，那就在每个场景下只记录这四种画面。
Since you don't know what to shoot, just record these four kinds of shots in each scene.
Four shots per scene.
场景空镜，物品特写，人物全景，人物近景。
Scene wide shots, item close-ups, full-body people, and close person shots.
The four-shot formula.

scenes.scene_zh: 空镜拍摄：可用固定拍摄，尽量让画面内的物体运动起来；也可用更有氛围感的移动拍摄，用稳定器做横移或升降，增加电影感。
scenes.scene_en: Wide shots: use fixed shooting and let things move inside the frame; or use more atmospheric moving shots with a gimbal—slow pans or rising/lowering moves—to add a cinematic feel.
scenes.context: 空镜要有动感，移动镜头用稳定器保证稳定。
sentences: 拍摄场景空镜时，可以选择使用固定拍摄，尽量保证画面内的物体运动起来。
For wide shots, you can use fixed shooting and try to keep things moving inside the frame.
Motion inside the frame.
同时也可以使用更有氛围感的移动拍摄。
You can also use more atmospheric moving shots.
Moving shots add mood.
拍摄一些慢慢横移的画面，又或者是使用自由抚养模式拍摄升降的画面。
Shoot slow horizontal pans, or use free-tilt mode for rising and lowering moves.
Pan and tilt moves.
来增加画面的电影感。
To add a cinematic feel.
Cinematic flair.

scenes.scene_zh: 人物全景：把手放到较远位置，打开三脚架和延长杆，固定镜头让人物慢慢入画，把环境和人物一起记录下来。
scenes.scene_en: Full-body shots: place the phone farther away, open the built-in tripod and extension rod, fix the shot, and let the person walk slowly into frame—capturing both the environment and the person.
scenes.context: 全景兼顾环境与人物，入画动作更自然。
sentences: 可以把手拿到比较远的位置，来获得人物全景的画面。
You can place the phone farther away to get a full-body shot of the person.
Frame the whole person.
打开自带的三角架和延长杆，选择固定镜头拍摄，让人物慢慢入画。
Open the built-in tripod and extension rod, fix the shot, and let the person slowly enter the frame.
Let them walk in.
这样就能把环境和人物一起记录下来。
This captures both the environment and the person together.
Context plus subject.

scenes.scene_zh: 追踪拍摄：使用稳定器自带的追踪功能拍摄人物移动画面，即使大范围环绕也能保持人物始终在画面中心，还可调智能美学构图改变位置。
scenes.scene_en: Tracking: use the gimbal's built-in tracking to film the person moving—even big circling moves keep the person centered; you can also tap smart composition to adjust the framing.
scenes.context: 稳定器的原生追踪让移动拍摄无死角。
sentences: 也可以使用稳定器自带的追踪功能，来拍摄一段人物移动的画面。
You can also use the gimbal's built-in tracking to film the person moving.
Let the gimbal follow.
哪怕是大范围的环绕移动，也能保证水平360度的无死角跟拍。
Even large circling moves deliver seamless 360-degree tracking.
360-degree no-dead-angle tracking.
完全不用担心人物出镜拍不到的问题。
No worries about the person leaving the frame.
Always in frame.
不管怎么移动，都能保证人物始终在画面的中心。
No matter how you move, the person stays centered.
Always centered.
点击智能美学构图，就能调整跟踪的位置。
Tap smart composition to adjust the tracking position.
Fine-tune the framing.

scenes.scene_zh: 人物近景：配合一些人物进行画面，让身体站满画面一半，继续做手上的事；配合另一台手机副屏遥控，高效调整画面。
scenes.scene_en: Close person shots: add shots of the person mid-action, filling half the frame while doing what they're doing; pair a second phone as a remote preview to frame efficiently.
scenes.context: 近景让视觉焦点明确，副屏遥控提升效率。
sentences: 配合上一些人物进行画面，视觉的焦点就会更明确。
Add some in-action person shots and the visual focus becomes clearer.
Action shots add focus.
让自己的身体站满拍摄画面的一半，然后继续做手上的事情就好。
Fill half the frame with your body and just keep doing what you're doing.
Half-frame, natural action.
配合上另一台手机，使用副屏遥控的功能，就能更高效的把画面调整成自己想要的樣子。
Pair a second phone and use remote preview to frame the shot efficiently.
Remote preview control.

scenes.scene_zh: 物品特写：拍摄当下拿着的物品或环境里的小东西，增加整个视频的沉浸感。
scenes.scene_en: Item close-ups: film what you're holding or little things around you to deepen the immersion of the whole video.
scenes.context: 特写镜头让观众更身临其境。
sentences: 拍摄一些物品特写的镜头，不管是当下拿着的物品，还是环境里的小东西。
Shoot item close-ups, whether it's what you're holding or small things in the environment.
Details everywhere.
都可以把他们拍摄下来，来增加整个视频的沉浸感。
Film them all to increase the immersion of the video.
Immersion through detail.

scenes.scene_zh: 结尾：把这四种画面进行随机组合，配上一首喜欢的音乐，整个视频就会更有电影感，也更有自己的风格。
scenes.scene_en: Ending: mix and match these four kinds of shots, add a song you love, and the whole video becomes more cinematic and more you.
scenes.context: 组合剪辑+音乐，最终成型。
sentences: 只需要把这四种画面进行上下随机组合。
Just mix and match these four kinds of shots.
Assemble the four types.
再配上一首自己喜欢的音乐，整个视频就会变得更有电影感。
Add a song you love and the video becomes more cinematic.
Music sells the mood.
同时也会更有自己的风格。
And it'll feel more like your own style.
Your signature look.
